headline: Software choice and auditing shape proteomics DIA and DDA identification
label: Proteomics Software Benchmarking
summary: Recent tools target auditing and accessibility of omics software output, with DIA-NN EasyFilter assessing DIA-NN PARQUET results without coding.
synthesis: The four items converge on software infrastructure that wraps, filters, or guides established omics analysis rather than introducing new measurement methods. DIA-NN EasyFilter, a KNIME workflow, filters, visualizes and assesses DIA-NN proteomics output stored in PARQUET files without requiring coding, directly addressing critical assessment of a widely used proteomics tool's results. DoTools, a cross-language R/Python framework, wraps scVI, CellTypist and CellBender into Seurat, SCE and Scanpy scRNA-seq workflows. OmicsMLMentor offers 15 machine learning models for omics data with missingness handling, normalization tests and model ranking in an open-source web app. AutoRNAseq, a Snakemake workflow preprint, automates bulk RNA-seq retrieval, reference preparation, QC, alignment and quantification for reproducibility. Within this set, only EasyFilter concerns proteomics directly; the new element is tooling that audits, standardizes or lowers barriers to output from existing software, rather than new algorithms benchmarked against them.
